issue.standard_remedy: Map the sub-tier and qualify an alternate
issue.summary: Depends on a single-source sub-tier supplier (Europe)

plan.diagnosis: Crescent Advanced Components GmbH presents a single-source sub-tier dependency risk with USD 4,790,296 in annual spend and a low resiliency score of 53. The supplier experienced 2 disruption events in the past 12 months and relies on 38 sub-tier suppliers in Europe, creating concentration risk that could cascade through our supply chain.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct sub-tier mapping exercise with Crescent Advanced Components to identify the critical single-source sub-tier supplier(s) among their 38 sub-tier base and document alternative sources
Qualify and onboard at least one alternate supplier for the affected product categories representing the USD 4.79M spend, prioritizing vendors outside Europe to reduce geographic concentration
remedy_steps.owner: Sourcing Manager with Quality Engineering support

remedy_steps.step: Negotiate contractual requirement with Crescent Advanced Components to maintain dual sub-tier sources for critical materials and improve resiliency score above 70
Implement multi-sourcing strategy to split the USD 4.79M spend 70/30 between Crescent and qualified alternate, with trigger clauses for further rebalancing if disruption events recur
Establish quarterly business continuity reviews with Crescent Advanced Components to monitor sub-tier changes, disruption risks, and resiliency score improvements

plan.expected_impact: Mitigate supply chain disruption risk affecting USD 4,790,296 in annual spend by establishing dual sourcing and improving supplier resiliency from score 53 to target 70+
kpis: Resiliency score improvement from 53 to 70+ within 6 months
Reduction in disruption events from 2 to 0 over next 12 months
Achievement of 70/30 spend split (USD 3.35M / USD 1.44M) between primary and alternate supplier by day 120
Sub-tier transparency: 100% visibility into critical sub-tier sources by day 30
Alternate supplier qualification completion rate: 100% by day 90
risks: Alternate supplier qualification may exceed 90-day timeline if technical specifications are complex or quality certification is delayed
Crescent Advanced Components may resist contractual requirements for sub-tier dual sourcing, potentially requiring escalation or relationship strain
Splitting USD 4.79M spend may result in 5-8% price increase due to loss of volume leverage with Crescent
New supplier ramp-up could introduce quality or delivery issues during transition period
Geographic diversification outside Europe may increase logistics costs and lead times by 10-15%
erp_actions: SAP: Create source list entries (ME01) for new alternate supplier with 30% quota arrangement and existing supplier at 70% quota for affected material numbers
SAP: Update info records (ME11) with dual-source pricing and lead times for all materials currently sourced from Crescent Advanced Components
SAP: Add supplier evaluation criteria (ME61) to track resiliency score and sub-tier transparency metrics for Crescent (vendor master LFA1)
Coupa: Flag Crescent Advanced Components with 'Single-Source Sub-Tier Risk' tag and set up automated alerts for disruption events or resiliency score changes below 65
Oracle EBS: Implement approved supplier list (ASL) updates to include alternate supplier for affected item categories with equal approval status
Dynamics 365: Configure dual-source procurement policy rules to enforce 70/30 split and require justification for any single-source POs exceeding USD 50,000
NetSuite: Create custom field in vendor record to track sub-tier supplier count (38) and resiliency score (53) with quarterly review workflow
